reviews.review: Is it as polished and excellent as ME2?  No, but how many games are?  Got a bad rap from launch problems and residual nerd rage over the ending to ME3.  But it's definitely worth playing.

What's the deal with faces? Even after my customization,I feel like I've taken a ride through the ugly festival. LOL. It's not a deal breaker. But it kind changes the dream like quality of it, giving it a more B quality. I'm fine with that. I like the b.  Why are video games starting to feel uncomfortable with having a pleasant person to follow around. I've noticed this in the new tomb raiders as well. Is that more bullitically core-icked? Does it give ya some feel goods and yet push that sadistic button just a little bit does it? Good times.

game is perfect by technical point of view. gameplay, visual, music and atmosphere. but, as for me, it is very easy even on insane level. versatility of gears is useless. also, game is overload with feminism. plot is fine.

Came back to this game WELL after launch. Seems the animations have been greatly improved over the launch edition that I had immediately refunded. As a separate ME story, it was good. It seems a lot of the negative reviews are people who wish it was, thought it was, or want it to be a continuance of Mass Effect 2/3 and they can't seem to understand that. The gameplay is much faster paced than ME 2/3 and the abilities and movements are much more diverse than the other games. Unfortunately, only 3 powers can be used at once using the new UI. No more quick pausing to select powers. Switching profiles is also not as intuitive as it should be: would have been great if you could hotswap on-the-fly like Alec Ryder was doing in the prologue mission and would swap your power bar accordingly. Having at least one set (preferably 2 sets) of skill/power bar abilities to quickly flip to would have made the profile system a lot better and make more sense without having to constantly pause the game.

The gunplay is really fun, with lots of weapons and skills, and the art direction is great, specially for the maps and environments, BUT the game is really buggy, and the writing is really weak compared to the original trilogy

It's a fun game, just don't pay full price for it
